verdict.rationale: Skyvern's product page states that generated Playwright code is cached after the first run. Repeat runs then skip the LLM entirely and are described as 3–5× faster, up to 70% cheaper and fully deterministic, which matches the story directly. The claim rests on a single marketing statement, with no developer documentation on how the cache is used or controlled. Missing for 10: in-depth developer docs on cache configuration, invalidation and fallback when a site changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed, cost and determinism claims.
